title: OpenAI classifies Astra as its first ‘Critical’ cyber model
friendlyTitle: OpenAI says Astra needs its strongest cyber safety controls
summary: OpenAI says its forthcoming Astra model can autonomously find and exploit previously unknown flaws in hardened systems, meeting the company’s Critical cybersecurity threshold. It plans a staged release with restricted advanced cyber access, stronger monitoring and pauses when agent behavior appears unauthorized.
friendlySummary: OpenAI says Astra can find and use serious software weaknesses with little human help. Its strongest cyber features will only be available to approved users at first.
whyItMatters: The release shows why capability and access policy now arrive as one product decision. Security professionals may gain stronger defensive tools, while ordinary users should expect more checks and occasional interruptions when long-running agents approach sensitive actions.
friendlyWhyItMatters: The model may help defenders fix systems, but it could also be misused. Strong access rules and monitoring are therefore part of the release.
